title: Bell of Revelation
description: A surreal scene shows a giant ornate bell suspended by chains in front of a dark gothic tower. A spectral robed figure with a crown ascends a blood-red staircase toward the bell, while a massive all-seeing eye with a rainbow pupil watches from the stormy sky above, flanked by rainbow curtains and giant clutching hands.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a giant ornate bell hanging by heavy chains before a dark gothic tower. A translucent crowned figure in ornate robes ascends a long red staircase toward the bell. Massive all-seeing eye with rainbow iris dominates the stormy sky above, flanked by colorful rainbow curtains and giant grey hands. Red petals and floating papers swirl in the air, turbulent red waves at the base, dramatic cinematic lighting.
